name: RankSlide
summary: Reads your Google Search Console data, flags traffic drops by page and keyword and suggests likely causes; every plan has every feature.
best_for: bloggers, in-house SEOs and agencies who want a daily alert when a page or keyword loses Google traffic, with a likely cause attached
skip_if: you need rank tracking outside Google, you need clear refund terms before you pay, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: It only reads Google Search Console, so it says nothing about other search engines. The page text shows no refund or cancellation terms, and the demo uses sample data rather than a real site.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter yearly · Starter is $48 a year for 1 site (shown as $4 a month, $5 a month on monthly billing)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-11 on rankslide.com/pricing, US dollars) RankSlide sells four plans and says every plan includes every feature; the plans differ by the number of sites. Starter covers 1 site and costs $48 a year, shown as $4 a month on yearly billing against $60 a year. Pro covers 5 sites for $106 a year, shown as $8.83 a month. Agency covers 25 sites for $278 a year, shown as $23.17 a month. Scale is for more than 25 sites and is priced per site: the page shows $331.20 a year for 30 sites, and the per-site price on monthly billing falls from $5.00 for one site to $1.15 at the largest tier. Yearly billing is 20% cheaper than monthly. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and the page says no card is needed. We did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.
